questions.question: A single line-to-ground (SLG) fault occurs on phase A of an unloaded, balanced three-phase power system. If the pre-fault phase voltage is V_f and the sequence impedances looking into the fault point are Z_0, Z_1, and Z_2 for zero-, positive-, and negative-sequence respectively, what is the magnitude of the total fault current flowing into the ground?
The open-loop transfer function of a unity feedback control system is given by G(s) = 2 / [s(s + 1)(s + 2)]. What are the phase crossover frequency (omega_pc) and the Gain Margin (GM) in decibels?

A single-phase full-bridge (H-bridge) inverter produces a square-wave output voltage switching between +V_dc and -V_dc at a fundamental frequency f_0. What is the RMS value of the fundamental harmonic component of the output voltage?

A 4-pole, 60 Hz, 3-phase induction motor has a standstill rotor resistance per phase of R_2 = 0.2 ohms and a standstill rotor leakage reactance per phase of X_2 = 0.8 ohms. Neglecting stator impedance, at what slip value (s_max) does the motor develop its maximum electromagnetic torque?

In power system load flow analysis using the Newton-Raphson method, a system consists of N total buses, including 1 slack bus, M voltage-controlled (PV) buses, and (N - 1 - M) load (PQ) buses. What is the dimension of the Jacobian matrix used in the iterative solution?
